title: Guardia Offline report
description: JSON report written by `guardia scan`, format version 1.0. Secrets are never present: every string is redacted before writing.

status.description: PASS: every required scanner completed with no findings. FINDINGS: at least one finding. INCOMPLETE: a scanner, database or part of the snapshot was missing; missing coverage always wins over findings.

exitCode.description: Process exit code: 0 for PASS, 1 for FINDINGS, 2 for INCOMPLETE.

commit.description: Full SHA of the analyzed commit (40 hex for SHA-1 repositories, 64 for SHA-256 repositories), or null when the snapshot could not be created.

status.description: verified: a network-isolation mechanism confirmed no outbound traffic. unverified: strict mode was requested but no mechanism exists. not_requested: strict mode was off.

complete.description: False when any entry could not be copied into the snapshot or when the snapshot failed.

excluded.description: Git entries deliberately not copied, such as symlinks and submodules.

omitted.description: Entries that could not be copied. Any value makes the snapshot incomplete.

error.description: Sanitized reason when the snapshot could not be created.

lockfiles.description: Lockfiles detected by name in the snapshot, relative to its root.

filesAnalyzed.description: Union of the files every scanner confirmed as fully reviewed, sorted.

omitted.description: Snapshot omissions followed by scanner omissions, each as `<scanner>: <path>: <reason>`.

scanners.description: One entry per required scanner, in the order osv, gitleaks.

findings.description: Every finding from every scanner, redacted.

id.description: Advisory identifier (for example GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx) or Gitleaks rule id.

path.description: Path relative to the snapshot root. Never a secret value.

summary.description: Redacted human-readable description. Never contains a secret value.

downloadedAt.description: When the offline database was downloaded, from guardia-db-meta.json, or null.

sourceDate.description: Date of the advisory data as reported by the source, or null when not provided.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the database file, recomputed on every run, or null when absent.

status.description: ok: the scanner completed. missing: binary or database not found. unsupported: nothing to analyze or the snapshot failed. error: the scanner failed.

version.description: Version reported by the binary, or null when it did not run.

filesAnalyzed.description: Only files for which this scanner confirmed a completed review.

omitted.description: Files or scopes for which coverage could not be established, as `<path>: <reason>`.

error.description: Sanitized diagnostic. Never scanner output that could contain a secret.
